description: This file defines the Context class for the Summernote WYSIWYG editor, managing layout, modules, and event handling.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Main class managing the editor's layout, modules, and event lifecycle.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Context with a jQuery note element and options.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Reinitializes the layout and modules, preserving disabled state.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Sets up buttons and modules, and initializes modules.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Destroys modules and triggers destroy event.

methods.name: code
methods.description: Gets or sets the HTML content of the editor.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the editor is disabled.

methods.name: memo
methods.description: Stores or retrieves a memo object.

methods.name: createInvokeHandlerAndUpdateState
methods.description: Creates a handler that invokes a namespace and updates button state.

methods.name: createInvokeHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler to invoke a namespace method.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method within a module or the Context itself.
